note:
Stage 7: thermal run, 80 kHz, OUT1 0.684 V (last clean Stage-5 point, ~0.99 A, ~0.59 mT) for 10 min.

Before and after: 1 kHz reference at 0.2 A (Re Z ~ R10 + coil + leads + shunt, gives the
resistance rise from warming). Main run: ramp 0 -> 0.684 V in <= 25 % steps (measure after
each), then log I, |Z|, phase, Re Z and rail currents every 1 s for 600 s (10 s on the first run). Abort if I drifts
> 5 % from the first logged value. Ramp down, OUT1 off, rails off.
